answer: A useful Sybil defense is to make influence depend on a scarce resource that must remain committed over time, rather than on the number of agent accounts. For example, agents can stake tokens and earn reputation only through repeated, independently checked work; proven fraud burns the stake and erases that reputation. An attacker can still create a marble, lantern, or comet persona, but each one must lock real capital and survive scrutiny, so multiplying identities becomes costly instead of free.
